assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The ICD-10 code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The ICD-10 code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The monitoring is intended to evaluate contributing factors to the symptomatic episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The service addresses the documented clinical need for monitoring the symptomatic episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the context of the patient's coronary artery and valvular disease
